## Evidence problem

- Stage: extraction / normalization / synthesis / validation / publish / update
- source ID:
- unit ID:
- locator or expected locator:
- What can the reviewer verify from the source?

## Reports and controls

Attach only redacted JSON/Markdown reports or synthetic fixtures. Include the quality report, content-integrity report, and compilation-artifact result when available. State whether the issue is reproducible with Mock LLM and which negative control should fail closed.

## Privacy and rights

- [ ] The fixture is original, synthetic, or lawfully shareable.
- [ ] No source full text, credential, prompt, private path, or raw provider response is included.
